summary.en: Open routed member questions as ordinary Host Sessions in the invitation-bound Workspace, with Decision Briefs injected before any model turn.
summary.zh: 将定向成员提问作为普通 Host Session 打开到邀请绑定的 Workspace，并在任何模型 turn 之前注入决策简报。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: The planner follows shared Client Runtime packages, but Mobile does not compose the Web member-question plugin or receiving-session Host path.
The planner follows shared lockfile and aggregate build inputs; the receiving Session materializer is Host Web/Desktop-only and no Platform image or deployment input changes.
